data.name: Project Car
data.detailed_description:
Project Car is a 3D survivor-like where your vehicle is both your movement kit and your combat build. Drive, drift, boost, jump, and fight through enemy waves while collecting upgrades that reshape your weapons, summons, and handling.

Every run is about momentum. Keep moving to survive, use handbrake drift to slip through pressure, hit nitro to escape bad angles, and turn the car's physics into a combat tool. Build around bullets, magic effects, turrets, shock pulses, oil slicks, spike strips, bumper blades, repair drones, shields, and vehicle upgrades.

Features

- Physics-based driving with custom suspension, steering, drift, nitro, dash, flip, and air-control systems.

- Survivor-style runs with enemy waves, elites, bosses, pickups, chests, and escalating pressure.

- Multiple vehicle archetypes, including cars, trucks, and motorbikes with different handling profiles.

- Build paths across ranged weapons, magic area attacks, trail weapons, melee-impact tools, summons, turrets, repair drones, shields, and car stat upgrades.

- Momentum-focused decisions: speed, drift, airtime, boost timing, and positioning all matter.

- Meta progression through quests, diamonds, unlocks, and main-menu upgrades.

Project Car blends arcade vehicle handling with the build-crafting loop of modern survivor games: create a loadout, survive the run, collect rewards, and come back with a stronger garage.

data.short_description: Project Car is a 3D bullet-heaven survivor where driving skill is your build. Drift, boost, dash, and smash through enemy swarms, collect powerful weapons and upgrades, then spend your rewards in the garage to push your next run further.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: VR not supported
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: VR not supported
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 quad-core processor or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible graphics card
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: macOS-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. Apple Silicon supported.
